title: Initialize portable source identity without transport credentials
preconditions: Use a Git checkout whose origin is https://user:secret@EXAMPLE.TEST/acme/app.git/.

steps.action: Discover the source identity used by initialization.
steps.expected_result: It becomes https://example.test/acme/app.git with no username or credential.

steps.action: Initialize a new Saga and inspect its source identity through public query.
steps.expected_result: The persisted source repository equals the portable canonical identity.

expected_result: The persisted source repository equals the portable canonical identity.
